messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: Dedicated customer 'Newport Health' -> 2026-06-15 22:00 UTC (2h change window). Release artifact: rwd-infer@v3.8.2. Model pin: stable-2026-06-01. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Please ACK and call out blockers.

maria: ACK. I'll be the primary on-call for this window, available +1h after deploy for post-checks. :white_check_mark:

lee: Quick flag — is there any overlap with infra KMS rotations? Our infra schedule shows a rotation at 22:30 for hosted keys.

ankita: That hosted rotation shouldn't affect Dedicated, but customer informed us they might rotate their CMK at ~23:00 in their VPC. CS asked us to coordinate. Recommend we push canary step timings to avoid 22:50-23:10.

samuel: Suggest cadence: canary at 22:05 (10%), hold 12m for metrics, 22:20 -> 50%, then full 22:40. If customer rotates at 23:00 their traffic will see steady state. Keeps the risky bits separated.

sean: I pulled last dry-run canary metrics for v3.8.2 (staging):
```
canary_slice: 3
requests: 1200
latency_p50: 82ms
latency_p95: 180ms
error_rate_5xx: 0.18%
avg_tokens_per_call: 42
```
Numbers look fine but p95 spikes on long contexts — we should watch that.

maria: Rollback criteria proposal: if 5xx >= 1.0% for 10m OR p95 latency > 400ms for 15m -> trigger rollback to rwd-infer@v3.8.1 and pin model back to stable-2026-05-15. Also disable prefix caching during first 10m of canary to isolate KV cache regressions.

lee: +1. Also add traffic-shift escape hatch: if customer-reported errors appear (CS ticket created) -> immediate 0% traffic shift and notify ops channel.

ankita: Release notes blurb ready — small tokenizer tweak, batching optimizations, kv-cache eviction fix. Marked as NON-breaking. Adding CS (cs-sara) to the thread for customer comms.

cs-sara: Thanks — I'll tell Newport Health their rotate at 23:00 won't impact the canary if we follow the cadence above. I'll also ask them to pause their rotation by 10m if they see anomalies.

deploy-bot: Canary job started at 22:05 UTC (canary-id: cb-4856781234-01). Config: canary_pct=10, slice_count=3, batch=auto, model=rwd-infer@v3.8.2.

sean: I'll tail canary logs and post a summary at +12m. If I see >0.5% 5xx I'll call for a hold.

deploy-bot: Status update @22:17 UTC -> canary 10% HEALTHY. metrics: error_rate_5xx=0.12%, p95=190ms, cpu_gpu_util=68%. Proceed to 50% at 22:20 as planned.

maria: Thanks — leaving a final preflight checklist here: ops runbook uploaded, alerting thresholds set, rollback playbook pinned, CS notified, KMS coord done. Going to standby at 21:45 UTC. :boat:
